evaluation_status: retrospective: already inspected in v1, not a new independent test
target: unaltered positive observed invoice quantities for origin+1 through origin+28
selection: minimum pooled validation absolute error, separately per supplier and unit; evaluation cannot change selection
new_sku_evaluation: all future-selling unseen SKU scored with zero forecast and reported separately; never passed to model
monthly_policy: 2024 monthly net sales only as aggregate historical features; from 2025 detailed positive sales take precedence, never added to monthly export
availability_assumption: event-time replay; historical ingestion/revision timestamps are unavailable
group_policy: past sales only; no current or future stock, supplier categories, client attributes, inbound or externally supplied seasonality tables
